scope: The surviving Edificio de los Espejos in Quito, including the low ovoid cultural complex with its mirror-clad exterior, the Ágora roof and the National Museum of Ecuador public entry.
geometryBasis: The 32-point ovoid map outline spans approximately 122 m by 176 m. The institutional architecture guide places the museum in the Casa de la Cultura complex and describes the roofed Ágora.
sectionBasis: A pale low roof sits behind three horizontal levels of smoked mirrored glazing. The public entrance uses a charcoal sign and pale concrete edge. The surrounding terrain falls toward the park on the south side.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Municipal museum listing identifies the museum at the Casa de la Cultura on Avenida Patria.
The Quito architecture guide records the Casa de la Cultura ovoid complex, its museum entrances, and the separate Ágora roof.
The operator places the enclosed Teatro Ágora in the same ovoid Edificio de los Espejos.
The architecture fieldwork records the three-level museum building and its curved form.
